name: outofmymind
description: OutOfMyMind with Marvin. Don't Panic. A private, fully local voice assistant. Marvin, its AI, is knowledgeable, dependable, slightly sarcastic, and perhaps a little depressed about having to answer everyone's questions.
author: Charbel Choueiri

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/client install && npm --prefix mcp-plugins install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/client run typecheck && npm --prefix mcp-plugins run typecheck
